name: Under the Hood
description: a vertical short-form video series that explains how software and AI systems work, with diagrams that build as the narrator speaks

voice.instructions: An engineer showing a friend how a system works at a whiteboard. Clear, relaxed and precise; lands each component's name as it appears. Conversational, never a hype voice or a lecture. Never imitate a known person or character.

notices.ownership: Diagrams and narration are original. System details are cited in the sources below.
notices.nonAffiliation: Under the Hood is an independent educational series. Product names belong to their owners.
